name: zinit

patches.new: : # Pinned local tree has no remote fetch

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke: source "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/zinit.git/zinit.zsh"; mkdir -p "$HOME/local-zplugin"; print 'function offline_plugin_function() { print offline-plugin-ok; }' > "$HOME/local-zplugin/local-zplugin.plugin.zsh"; zinit light "$HOME/local-zplugin"; [[ "$(offline_plugin_function)" = offline-plugin-ok ]]
notes: Uses the official installer with fixed source archive for install/update transport. Git progress helper is not needed for local extraction. Supported NO_EDIT/NO_ANNEXES options avoid shell config edits and unrelated plugin downloads. Tests loading and invoking a local plugin.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
